## Summary

changed_defs.py gets a pure-bytes port of buildWorkflow (gen_build) and a tree blob reader (gen_blob).
When the dist plugins/fleet/workflows/build-task-run.js at the tree equals gen_build(src blob), it reports the dist in a new `generated` list and does not scan it. Otherwise it scans the dist as it does today.
buildCallerCheck validates `generated`. It accepts only the one dist path and logs 'skipped <path> (generated from src)'. A bad relay halts the step as failed.
The src stays scanned. Repos without this layout are unchanged. The fleet version goes to 7.0.1 and the pins, dist and README are regenerated or updated.

### Review S1 closed (commit 9c60c05)

The generated-dist skip now needs the dist to be the fresh build of the src at BOTH the base and the approved tree (gen_build(base src) == base dist AND gen_build(tree src) == tree dist). A stale base dist (hand edit in the dist only) is scanned, so its changed dist definitions (e.g. FLEET_VERSION, a dropped `const staleProbe = 2;`) reach the callers gate again. Re-run of review scenarios M3/M8 at e3c3ec2: old program `generated=[dist], defs=[]`; new program `generated=[]`, defs FLEET_VERSION and staleProbe reported.

Frozen test AC1 "boundary: stale base dist" pinned the old fail-open behaviour. The orchestrator corrected it to expect the dist scanned (plan defect; finished outside the fleet after needs_human). Measured: new test RED on 36cebe1, GREEN with the fix, RED again with the base-freshness check removed.

### Acceptance criteria

- AC1: [unit] changed_defs.py reports the dist plugins/fleet/workflows/build-task-run.js in a new output list `generated` and does not scan it when, at both the base and the tree, its blob equals buildWorkflow(blob of plugins/fleet/src/build-task-run.js) (base clause added by review S1); fixtures per the plan doc (SRC0, build(x) = JS buildWorkflow from plugins/fleet/scripts/build-workflow.mjs; base S=SRC0, D=build(SRC0), lib/other.js). Test: plugins/fleet/tests/v701_generated_skip.test.mjs
- AC2: [unit] When the dist blob at the tree differs from buildWorkflow(src blob), or the src blob is missing, or the dist is deleted, changed_defs.py scans the dist as today and `generated` is []; fixtures per the plan doc (SRC0, S, D, build). Test: plugins/fleet/tests/v701_generated_mismatch.test.mjs
- AC3: [unit] The src file plugins/fleet/src/build-task-run.js stays scanned: its changed definitions are listed in defs even when the dist is the fresh build; fixtures per the plan doc (SRC0, S, D, build). Test: plugins/fleet/tests/v701_src_scanned.test.mjs
- AC4: [unit] Repos without the ccpm src/dist layout are unaffected: `generated` is [] and every changed file is scanned as today; fixtures per the plan doc (SRC0, S, D, build). Test: plugins/fleet/tests/v701_other_layouts.test.mjs
- AC5: [unit] The workflow's build caller check carries `generated`: the changed_defs prompt lists it, a valid relay logs '<label>: skipped <path> (generated from src)' and the build continues; a relay with no generated array, a non-string entry, or an entry other than plugins/fleet/workflows/build-task-run.js halts the step as failed before any commit. Test: plugins/fleet/tests/v701_gate_log.test.mjs
- AC6: [unit] The program's build check equals the JS buildWorkflow byte for byte, including tab indentation, indented comment-only lines, whitespace-only lines, marker lines and the meta split; fixtures per the plan doc (SRC0, S, D, build). Test: plugins/fleet/tests/v701_build_parity.test.mjs
